import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { language } from "../../../backend/schema/language";

export const languageCms = customizeTable<typeof language>("language", {
    group: "Reference",
    display: {
        title: "name"
    },
    sort: ["lastUpdate", "desc"],
    fields: {
        name: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    }
});
